checks: The launcher waits for a ruleset before starting a battle.
One edited table column changes only its selected ruleset.
An invalid balance row is rejected with the key that needs correction.
The menu switch enables Simplified Chinese with a CJK glyph.
The PC entry loads PC settings and carries Chinese into the combat HUD.
The PC entry preserves hit points and the initial lives.
Returning to the launcher preserves the language and stops the battle.
The classic entry applies original-style survival, terrain and fire timing.
F1's language action updates the active HUD immediately.
A classic armored aircraft absorbs the first hit with a shield.
A follow-up hit destroys the aircraft while the shield is down.
Classic extra rockets can raise the slot count past the PC limit.
Picking up classic piercing clamps rocket capacity to two.
A classic hit costs a life and one available upgrade.
Restarting retains the ruleset and resets the run.
